q: We buy LPG on one bill for both the canteen and the process. Do we need to split it?
title: One LPG bill for canteen and process
short: Not for your company footprint: all LPG you burn is Scope 1 either way. Split it only for a product footprint, where canteen gas is usually left out as not attributable. Use a cylinder issue log or separate regulators to see how much goes where, and note the split method.

ul: Canteen use estimated from meals served, the rest to process.

p: LPG at 2.98 kg CO2 per kg, from IPCC 2006 defaults, whichever way it is split.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
